'''Rhiale''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is flame-haired.

==Strength and Abilities==
Rhiale can [[channel]] quite strongly. In TWoTC her strength level is described as {{opsl|25}}, the same level of [[Tamra]] and [[Gitara]], which is a high ranking level among [[Aes Sedai]].

This strength is more than enough to open alone a gateway for [[Travel]]ing. 

== Activities ==
She participated in the murder of [[Desaine]]. 
She fights in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. She was "Chosen from the strongest of the Shaido Wise Ones who could wield the One Power". However she morally draws the line in attacking the other Aiel clan Wise Ones during the battle.
She helps to activate the call box and is present when both Caddar ([[Sammael]]) and Maisia ([[Graendal]]) arrive.

She ends up Traveling to [[Ghealdan]]. With [[Therava]] and a few other Wise Ones she stands up to [[Sevanna]] and begins to take away some of her power.
